dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' shaped structure on the upper dorsal-lateral region characterized by a high-contrast white perimeter and a dark, low-intensity interior. Several interlocking 'C' and 'O' shapes along the mid-lateral flank exhibit sharp outer edge gradients with high-intensity pixel transitions against the dark substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters is present in the central-lateral region where multiple annuli overlap. Lower density of isolated, solid white blobs is observed near the anterior flipper region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships formed by the centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli create an elongated, irregular quadrilateral spanning the mid-dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique chain-link pattern topology formed by the contiguous overlapping of several high-contrast light-colored rings along the lateral axis.
